alerts.title: Viral load monitoring overdue
alerts.message: Guidelines recommend routine viral load monitoring 6 months after ART initiation, then 12 months after, and thereafter every 1 year for adults. Patient's last viral load was 2025-09-15, 129 days before the visit. The next annual VL is due around 2026-09-15, so it is not yet overdue. However, the clinician's plan does not mention scheduling the next viral load test. Viral load is suppressed at 20 copies/mL, confirming treatment success.

evidence.recommended_action: Document the next scheduled viral load date (~2026-09-15) in the patient's care plan to ensure timely annual monitoring.

alerts.title: TDF renal monitoring frequency unclear
alerts.message: Guidelines require serum creatinine and eGFR at baseline for patients initiating TDF-based ART. The patient's creatinine was 76 umol/L on 2025-12-15, which is within normal range. However, only one creatinine result is available and no baseline or trend can be assessed. The clinician's plan does not include any renal monitoring orders. TDF can cause chronic kidney disease, acute kidney injury, and Fanconi syndrome, so ongoing periodic renal monitoring is important.

evidence.recommended_action: Continue periodic serum creatinine and eGFR monitoring as part of routine TDF safety surveillance; document monitoring schedule.
